This plot is very small, only a small corner of my land, and I grow sorghum here together with some beans between the rows. I have no money to buy fertilizer from the cooperative — one bag is too much for such a small piece, and the cash is not there anyway. I will put the manure from my few animals on the plot like I did last year, use the seed I saved from last harvest, and weed it myself with my children. Sorghum is strong, it does not need much fuss, and the rains here usually come enough for it.
